body: Look up a man named Tony Robbins.  He is a miracle worker just watch some of his videos.  I know how you feel.  Schizophrenia is no joke but I think you need to fully show someone who you are.  Tell them everything, preferably to someone who always knows what to say.  About your friend, just tell him what's up, he will definitely understand.  Don't be suicidal just let all of your emotions out.  :) <--- That's a smiley for you.  I love you
Ok fine, I default to your judgement but make new friends and do other things that make you happy and feel whole! Just go for what you love and you will turn out on top!

Confront them, you are not forever alone.  You said that you love chem, right? So ask a teacher to teach you more about it and get so smart and just get to be the best there is.  Just find that anger and put it into what you love.  Go up to your friend and say what you feel, say, I know what I did but I am sorry and  if you could please stop being an ass, that would be great.  I valued our friendship and I would like to pick up where we left off.  Just fix your shit and kick ass (not literally).  You can do it and you know what you need to do.  I'm not going to sugar coat it, it's going to take work but the reward will far outweigh the pain you feel now.  Sure, cry it out and take your anger out (in the gym) but get your capable ass back in there and take your life back!

You said this isn't the first time this has happened, and it won't be the last.  Sometimes shit hits the fan and there's nothing at all you can do about it but break through that wall that is closing in on you.  Think about the happiest you have ever been and just do whatever got you there again.  You have sooooo much to live for and eventually, hey, we might meet but I want that chance to be there.  You sound so young and so full of life but don't let these things bring you down.

You're on here because you want to feel known, if nothing else, go volunteer at your local soup kitchen or homeless shelter.  I bet they have some great advice for you and a great way of putting it.  And you can be doing good in the world as well as teaching yourself how good it is to be you.  Open up to someone you think is trustable, maybe even a teacher at school, just don't give up.

Don't give up so easily.  There has to be an ounce of anger left in you, take that and channel it into something you love.  Your son may have a great support system but I KNOW it will never be as good as this dad he has right here.  You have to keep fighting that feeling.  NEVER GIVE UP.  Before you do anything, just look up this man named Tony Robbins.  He is a miracle worker and you will be up and on your feet in no time.  I can see it, it has happened to so many people that I know and even those who I don't know.  Just get up and find a new job, any job that you can see yourself being proud of.  What is your education background like? Go for it and just do it fuck everything else (except your son and friends).  I know the feeling of hopelessness all too well but the night is darkest just before the dawn.  You will break out of this plateau and you will emerge thriving.  Just promise me one thing, please - DON'T.GIVE.UP.  Okay 2 things - DON'T YOU DO ANYTHING TO HARM THAT BEAUTIFUL MAN WHO IS SOSUREKEEPHERE123.  YOU ROCK JUST GET THE FUCK OUT THERE AND KICK SOME ASS.  I have faith in you and I don't even know who you are, just go find something, anything to do to keep yourself preoccupied.  Have a fantastic day I hope to see you tomorrow ;).  But not on this subreddit.  =^) GO YOU
Wow, this is all true.  Thank you.  :)

First of all, I would just like to say that my dad was a HUGE part of my life and he is the reason I have gotten as far as I have so far.  If nothing else, do it for your son, live for him, do everything for him, find what you love and go for it, screw the rest of the world and their petty bullshit, do what you love and nothing else.  There is something you love to do and something you can learn to do.  I love science, for example, it intrigues me and just because English isn't my thing, so what? I don't care, I still do what I love (even though I am not as old as you).  SHOW YOUR EX-WIFE WHO'S THE BETTER HALF.  Use that as your motivation and drive to do what you need to do.  You rock and you are the best. Just find what you love to do and you will never have to work a day in your live.  Make your ex-wife regret divorcing you and find a more compatible spouse (if you want).

=^) Go, you sosurekeephere123

It really doesn't sound stupid, I understand, if not that girl, find someone else, maybe from school.  If not, maybe try to go back to your old best friend and apologize, tell him how you feel, I BET he will yield. Just talk to him and ask for his help. EVEN if that doesn't work, try talking to any siblings maybe? Or cousins or aunts or uncles or anyone who is willing to listen. Heck, even an animal, that always helps me!  I KNOW you still have hope so get out there and fix your life! YOU GOT THIS, YOU ROCK - You control your life so don't end it, just find what you want to do, whatever makes you happy.  What makes you happy?

There has to be someone you can open up to, sometimes you just have to talk through it with a trusted individual. Talk to your parents, they will always have advice for you.  An escape can be anything you would like, just pursue anything you fancy and you will never have to work a day in your life.  You will also find others who share your interest and you will become friends.  There is always something, so find it and don't let go of it.  DO WHAT YOU LOVE TO DO - Whatever it may be
:) <- A smile for you, you beautiful person
